products.title: Dell Ultrasharp Monitor
products.description: Experience unparalleled visual comfort and productivity with the Dell UltraSharp 27 Thunderbolt Hub Monitor (U2724DE). This monitor is certified by TÜV for 5-star eye comfort and features extensive connectivity with Thunderbolt 4. Enjoy a smoother visual experience with a 120Hz refresh rate and superior image quality with IPS Black panel technology, offering deeper blacks and exceptional contrast. It delivers vivid, lifelike colors with wide color coverage and calibration accuracy. The single-cable Thunderbolt 4 connection transmits data and video signals at up to 40Gbps and delivers up to 90W of power to your PC. It also supports fast Ethernet speeds of up to 2.5GbE. Seamlessly switch between two PCs with Auto KVM and control both with a single keyboard and mouse. The monitor offers a virtually borderless InfinityEdge screen and a premium platinum silver finish. It's designed for comfort with adjustable tilt, swivel, pivot, and height. Dell Color Management software allows for customizable color calibration, and Dell Display Manager enhances productivity with features like Easy Arrange and USB KVM wizard. This monitor is environmentally conscious, using recycled plastics and aluminum, and meeting the latest environmental standards. It is compatible with multiple operating systems and includes essential connectivity options like HDMI, DisplayPort, and various USB ports.
